lines: “峰主，我要退峰！”
青阳剑宗
星陨峰
望着青年离去的背影，林玄摇了摇头，却也没太多伤感，这一幕在这三年间，不知重演过多少次了。
他已经有些麻木了。
“这样一来，星陨峰只剩下五人了吧？”林玄自言自语，这五人，还是加上他自己。
三年前，星陨峰是何等的繁荣，峰内弟子上万，位列青阳剑宗第十三峰，甚至有望冲击青阳剑宗前十峰。
可短短不到三年，星陨峰便从排名第十三，跌落到现如今第三十三。
要知道，整个青阳剑宗上下，也不过三十六峰罢了。
这一切，只因三年前发生的一场变故。
林玄最得意的弟子南宫邀月，在一次外出历练后便再也没回来过，起初林玄心急如焚，担心她是否是出了什么意外。
但就在三天后，随着一封书信送到青阳剑宗，送至林玄手上，他才知晓，自己所谓的担心，多余了。
信件由南宫邀月亲笔所写，内容便是向林玄辞别。
她并非遇到了什么危险，而是在历练的途中，遇到一人，那人自称是瑶池天宫宫主，见她天赋极佳，欲收她为徒。
而她，答应了。
看着信件，林玄沉默许久，最终自嘲一笑。
池瑶天宫，玄域霸主之一，宫主池瑶仙子更是玄域十大强者之一，一位尊者境大能。
而青阳剑宗，虽是唐清帝国十大宗门之一，但两者没有任何可比性。
玄域广袤无际，如唐清帝国这样的国家，不知凡几。
而池瑶天宫，那是在玄域都算得上巨头的势力，而青阳剑宗，哪怕是在这小小的唐清帝国，都排不上第一，两者的差距，可想而知。
炼体、聚气、地玄、天玄、劫境、王境、皇境、尊者、帝境、圣境……
偌大的唐清帝国，连一位皇境都没有，但在池瑶天宫，别说皇境，连尊者都不止一位。
此事对林玄的打击不可谓不大，甚至成为了他的心魔。
林玄一直将南宫邀月视作自己的骄傲，自收她入门起，对她的培养可谓倾尽全力，毫无保留，没想到换来的，却是这样的结果。
此事也直接导致了林玄在后来尝试突破王境之时，遭到反噬，不仅没突破成功，反而跌落了两个境界。
自那以后，林玄大部分时间都在闭关疗伤，峰内事务根本无暇处理。
而从那以后，星陨峰便开始逐年衰落。
别说没什么新弟子加入，就连原本星陨峰的弟子，都相继离开了星陨峰，加入其他峰了。
短短三年，物是人非。
对于南宫邀月的“背叛”，青阳剑宗有两种不同的声音，一种自然便是其忘恩负义。
也有一部分人认为，南宫邀月的选择没错。
毕竟……那可是一位尊者境大能亲自招揽，试问有几个人能抵挡得住这等诱惑？
而在南宫邀月，于半年前登临潜龙榜的消息在青阳剑宗内传开后，越来越多人觉得，当初南宫邀月脱离星陨峰，拜池瑶宫主为师的选择，无比正确。
继续留在这星陨峰，才是糟蹋了那绝世天资。
对于林玄，众人更多的则是唏嘘。
曾经宗内最炙手可热的峰主，有极大希望冲击王境的存在，却落得如今这般田地。
目送那弟子离开的林玄，突然发出一声轻咦，因为在杨昊头顶上方，一个虚拟框缓缓浮现……
姓名：杨昊
年龄：17
境界：聚气一重
身份：赤阳峰真传弟子

content_en:
"Peak Master, I want to retreat from the peak!"
Qingyang Sword Sect
Starfall Peak
Looking at the young man's leaving figure, Lin Xuan shook his head, but he was not too sad. This scene has been repeated countless times in the past three years.
He was already a little numb.
"In this way, there are only five people left in Xingyun Peak, right?" Lin Xuan said to himself, and among these five people, he should be added.
Three years ago, Starfall Peak was so prosperous. There were tens of thousands of disciples in the peak, ranking among the thirteenth peak of Qingyang Sword Sect, and even expected to reach the top ten peaks of Qingyang Sword Sect.
But in just less than three years, Starfall Peak fell from the thirteenth place to the thirty-third place now.
You know, the entire Qingyang Sword Sect only has thirty-six peaks.
All this happened only because of an incident three years ago.
Lin Xuan's most proud disciple, Nangong Yueyue, never came back after going out for training. At first, Lin Xuan was anxious, worried about whether something had happened to her.
But just three days later, when a letter was sent to Qingyang Sword Sect and delivered to Lin Xuan, he realized that his so-called worries were unnecessary.
The letter was written by Nangong Yaoyue himself, and the content was to bid farewell to Lin Xuan.
It was not that she encountered any danger, but during her training, she met a person who claimed to be the Lord of Yaochi Tiangong. Seeing that she was extremely talented, he wanted to accept her as his disciple.
And she agreed.
Looking at the letter, Lin Xuan was silent for a long time, and finally laughed at himself.
Chi Yao Heavenly Palace is one of the overlords of the Xuan Realm. The owner of the palace, Fairy Chi Yao, is one of the top ten powerful people in the Xuan Realm and a powerful master in the Venerable Realm.
Although the Qingyang Sword Sect was one of the ten major sects in the Tang and Qing Empire, there was no comparison between the two.
The Mysterious Territory is vast, and there are countless countries like the Tang and Qing Empires.
As for Chi Yao Heavenly Palace, it was a giant force in the Xuan Realm, while Qingyang Sword Sect was not ranked first even in the small Tang and Qing Empire. The gap between the two can be imagined.
Body refining, Qi gathering, Earth Mystery, Sky Mystery, Tribulation Realm, King Realm, Imperial Realm, Venerable Realm, Imperial Realm, Holy Realm...
The huge Tang and Qing empire didn't even have an emperor, but in Chiyao Heavenly Palace, let alone an emperor, there was more than one venerable person.
This incident had a huge impact on Lin Xuan, and even became his inner demon.
Lin Xuan has always regarded Nangong Yueyue as his pride. Since he accepted her as a disciple, he has devoted all his efforts to training her without any reservation. He did not expect to get such a result in exchange.
This incident also directly caused Lin Xuan to suffer backlash when he later tried to break through to the King Realm. Not only did he fail to break through, but he fell into two realms.
Since then, Lin Xuan has spent most of his time in seclusion to heal his wounds, and has no time to deal with matters within the peak.
Since then, Starfall Peak has begun to decline year by year.
Not to mention that there are not many new disciples joining, even the original disciples of Starfall Peak have left Starfall Peak one after another and joined other peaks.
In just three years, things have changed and people have changed.
Regarding Nangong Yaoyue's "betrayal", the Qingyang Sword Sect had two different voices. One was naturally ungrateful.
There are also some people who believe that Nangong Yaoyue made the right choice.
After all... that was personally recruited by a great master of the Venerable Realm. How many people can resist such temptation?
After the news that Nangong Yaoyue was on the Hidden Dragon List half a year ago spread within the Qingyang Sword Sect, more and more people felt that Nangong Yaoyue's choice to leave Starfall Peak and become the master of Palace Master Chi Yao was extremely correct.
Continuing to stay in Xingyun Peak would be a waste of that peerless talent.
For Lin Xuan, everyone was more sighing.
Once the most popular peak master in the sect, he had great hopes of reaching the king realm, but he ended up in this situation now.
"Huh?"
Lin Xuan, who was watching the disciple leave, suddenly let out a sigh, because above Yang Hao's head, a virtual frame slowly appeared...
Name: Yang Hao
Age: 17
Realm: Qi Gathering Level 1
Identity: True disciple of Chiyang Peak
Destiny: The body possesses the root of wisdom (Green 6th grade)
